ai-image-prompts v1.0.3

- Documentation (SKILL.md) updated with minor edits.

ai-image-prompts 1.0.2

- Enforces that every prompt recommendation includes a sample image; text-only prompts are no longer allowed.
- Adds explicit instructions to always send the first sample image (`sourceMedia[0]`) with each prompt and to skip prompts without images.
- Updates documentation to make sample images mandatory for all prompt listings.

- Updated library size references from 14,000+ to 10,000+ prompts throughout documentation.
- Refreshed prompt category counts and file listings to match the latest reference data.
- Minor adjustments in README and documentation to improve clarity and accuracy.
- No changes to core logic or usage: compatibility and workflow remain unchanged.

ai-image-prompts-skill 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Recommend curated prompts from a library of 14,000+ real-world image generation prompts suitable for any AI image model.
- Supports keyword and category-based search with dynamic, auto-synced reference categories.
- Provides sample images and customizable prompt templates for various content, including social media, marketing, portraits, illustrations, and more.
- Automatic library updates and freshness checks on every use.
- Mandatory attribution footer included with all prompt responses, in user’s language.
